description: One nudge per session toward the system map before the first Grep in a mapped repository with code facts. Fails open.

args: if command -v cartographer >/dev/null 2>&1; then cartographer hook grep; elif command -v mise >/dev/null 2>&1; then p=$(mise -C / exec github:shermanhuman/cartographer -- sh -c 'command -v cartographer' </dev/null 2>/dev/null) && [ -n "$p" ] && "$p" hook grep; fi; exit 0
